If still tied, tied players share the victory.

notes: family: point-salad-euro. Game ends 2 full turns each after the Sun Tracker reaches the last Sun Track space. Final scoring order: Captivity -3 Spirit each, Spirit track RP, Seasons left to right, Creatures. Season tile conditions, Spirit area values and per-Creature needs are printed on components/rulebook p.12 (Mushfrog 3/adjacent Tree, Antlerworm 3/Coral, Spiderant 2/different habitat, Wiseowl 2/Mushroom + 1 per 2 Gifts, Grimster 2/Flower + 3/aligned Mushfrog, Tailcat 2/Weed + 3/aligned Antlerworm); enter totals. Midnight River expansion (fish tiles) and Winds of Change cards not modelled. Solo (Feronia) and Midnight River/solo rules not modelled.
